desc: Prove the structural reduction: an answer equals the maximum value of selecting \(2K\) cakes and labeling each by one coordinate, with every label count even.
Derive and rigorously prove a baseline-and-parity-repair algorithm with at most two exchanges from the top-\(2K\) baseline.
Formulate the parity optimization as an 8-mask DP, including tied coordinate values and prevention of cake reuse.
Prove the outside-candidate pruning bound of at most two best candidates per coordinate and the resulting complexity.
Validate the finalized algorithm on public samples and relevant edge cases.
